children: The Boring Company is working on a high-speed tunnel that could transport passengers between Austin and San Antonio in less than 30 minutes, Elon Musk says. The suggested system would go faster than 200 mph, Musk said.

The route is about 80 miles, but can take up to 2.5 hours due to congestion. A tunnel built for faster speeds may thus be an alternative to highway travel, and perhaps even compete with airlines and future passenger rail.

The Boring Company is privately held, therefore the project does not directly contribute financially to Tesla (TSLA, Financials) at this time. But the concept might become meaningful to investors if Tesla technology, automobiles or infrastructure are included in the system at some point.

Details are unknown. Musk has not revealed a final route, construction cost, financing plan or completion date. It is also unclear if the system would be based on ordinary electric vehicles, dedicated passenger pods, or Hyperloop-style design.
The business currently has an underground transit system in Las Vegas but an Austin-San Antonio line would be far longer and speedier.

The next big trigger for investors is whether Musk can present a concrete path, finance plan or construction date. The concept is currently more of a hypothetical expansion of The Boring Company than a verified Tesla growth driver.

title: Musk Has a New Route for Texas and It's Underground
